title: Which project details help a commercial buyer understand the work
body:
Read the fictional warehouse example and compare its input with the draft case study. Which practical details help a buyer understand scope and delivery? Share anonymised structures rather than confidential project documents. [Electrician Web Design](https://electricianwebdesign.uk/) maintains this resource. Technical installation advice is outside the project's scope; content and workflow improvements are welcome.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Electrician-Web-Design/electrical-project-story-builder#readme), then run the documented example locally.
